applicationInfo.name: taskboard
applicationInfo.description: Demo taskboard service guarded by the PR-surface agentic gates

threats.statement: An external actor supplying a crafted search or filter string [TB-INGRESS] can inject SQL through string-built LIKE clauses, which leads to disclosure or tampering of all task rows [TB-DATA]
mitigations: Sentinel persona + deterministic review on every PR

threats.statement: A debug or telemetry change [TB-PIPELINE] can log Authorization headers or tokens crossing the ingress [TB-INGRESS], which leads to credential disclosure in log storage
mitigations: SEC-002 blocking rule (no secrets in logs)
Structured telemetry helpers scrub sensitive headers

threats.statement: A malicious change author [TB-PIPELINE] can embed instructions to the review agents in code or comments, which leads to the gate approving a harmful change if verdicts followed model prose
mitigations: Verdicts derive from rule metadata + counts, never prose
Reviewer tooling and rules load from the BASE ref

threats.statement: An over-permissive IAM statement introduced in infra/service.template.json [TB-PIPELINE] can grant the service wildcard access, which leads to privilege escalation beyond the task datastore [TB-DATA]
mitigations: Deterministic lane: wildcard-IAM check + IAM Access Analyzer ValidatePolicy
IAM-002 blocking rule in the agent panel

threats.statement: A defective publisher [TB-PIPELINE] can flood or poison the task-event topic, which leads to denial of service or bad state for downstream consumers [TB-EVENTS]
mitigations: Publish failures logged, dead-letter queue on consumers
Least-privilege sns:Publish scoped to the one topic

lastReviewed: 2026-08-18 — initial model for the taskboard service
